name: Air filters (HEPA and carbon)
summary: Pleated HEPA, carbon and furnace filters that trap dust, smoke, mould spores and fumes.
uses: Cleaner air in a sealed room during smoke or dust
A box fan with a furnace filter strapped on makes a room air cleaner
Carbon filters cut fumes and smells
Replacement filters for vacuums and purifiers
identify: Flat pleated panels in furnaces and air handlers (sizes like 16 × 25 × 1 in), white HEPA cartridges in air purifiers and vacuums, and black carbon pads in range hoods and purifiers. MERV 11–13 or HEPA on the label means fine filtering.
test: Hold it to the light: the media should be whole, with no tears or gaps at the frame. Grey loaded media still works but slows airflow; throw out damp or musty ones, and bag used filters because they hold dust and spores.

decay.note: Sealed spares last; used and damp filters grow mould.
